title: Herring Talk to Each Other With Farts. Scientists Won an Ig Nobel

scenes.text: Herring talk to each other through their rear ends.
Scientists call the sound a fast repetitive tick.
It happens mostly at night, when gas bubbles escape the fish.
The ticks are too high-pitched for most predators to hear.
So a school can stay together in the dark without being noticed.
The team that found it won an Ig Nobel Prize.

description:
Herring talk to each other through their rear ends.
Researchers recorded fast repetitive tick sounds at night, and the study won an Ig Nobel Prize.
What is the weirdest animal language you know?
first_comment: Which would you rather learn: fish language or bird language?
